tickets.title: Obtain federal estimated tax payment confirmation
tickets.text: Obtain the missing federal estimated tax payment confirmation for Serena Willowdoodle, corresponding to the state payment voucher in the CPA portal.
tickets.evidence: For estimated tax payment confirmation, Serena saw a state payment voucher in the CPA portal but did not see the corresponding federal payment confirmation before the next payment window. The agreed work is to obtain the corresponding federal payment confirmation, dated 2024-12-24.

tickets.title: Provide consolidated written service matter status log
tickets.text: Provide Serena Willowdoodle with one consolidated written log of each unresolved operational issue in the household’s open service matter status log, including the responsible party and the next status checkpoint.
tickets.evidence: Serena requested one consolidated written log showing each unresolved operational issue, the responsible party, and the next status checkpoint because prior updates arrived in separate portal messages and emails. The agreed work is to provide the consolidated written log, dated 2024-12-18.

tickets.title: Restore Teacup Comet Bank cash dashboard access
tickets.text: Restore Serena Willowdoodle’s read-only access to the Teacup Comet Bank cash dashboard. The prior authorization no longer appears active.
tickets.evidence: Serena asked Apricot Compass Wealth Advisory to restore read-only access to the Teacup Comet Bank cash dashboard because the prior authorization no longer appears active. The agreed work is to restore read-only dashboard access, dated 2024-12-19.

tickets.title: Coordinate temporary mailing and delivery setup
tickets.text: Coordinate the Willowdoodles’ temporary mailing and delivery setup during the home renovation. Recent account correspondence still reflected the prior delivery setup.
tickets.evidence: Serena reported that recent account correspondence still reflected the prior delivery setup. The agreed work is to coordinate the temporary mailing and delivery setup, dated 2024-12-27.

tickets.title: Correct custodian login security routing
tickets.text: Correct the Velvet Acorn Custody login security routing for Jasper Willowdoodle’s IRA. Authentication texts tied to Serena’s IRA login do not match the household’s intended credential separation.
tickets.evidence: Jasper received authentication texts tied to Serena’s IRA login, which does not match the household’s intended credential separation. The agreed work is to correct the custodian login security routing, dated 2024-12-17.

tickets.title: Resolve duplicate Jasper profile for electronic signature packet
tickets.text: Resolve the duplicate Jasper Willowdoodle profile in the portal that prevented Jasper from completing the electronic signature packet for household records.
tickets.evidence: the portal shows two Jasper profiles, and the duplicate profile prevented Jasper from completing an electronic signature packet for household records. The agreed work is to resolve the duplicate Jasper profile issue affecting the electronic signature packet, dated 2024-12-20.

tickets.title: Address taxable account cost basis feed discrepancy
tickets.text: Address the missing lot-level cost basis for three positions in the Willowdoodles’ joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody. The custodian statement shows basis amounts for those same holdings.
tickets.evidence: the Velvet Acorn Custody data feed shows missing lot-level basis for three positions in the joint taxable account, while the custodian statement shows basis amounts for those same holdings. The agreed work is to address the taxable account cost basis feed discrepancy, dated 2024-12-23.

tickets.title: Address trusted contact field inconsistency
tickets.text: Address the trusted contact field inconsistency in the Willowdoodles’ Velvet Acorn Custody records. The joint taxable account lists a trusted contact, but Serena’s IRA profile does not show a trusted contact entry.
tickets.evidence: a service review found that the joint taxable account lists a trusted contact, but Serena’s IRA profile does not show a trusted contact entry in the custodian records. The agreed work is to address the trusted contact field inconsistency, dated 2025-01-03.

tickets.title: Revise renovation reserve reporting classification
tickets.text: Revise the Willowdoodles’ household performance report to classify the renovation reserve separately from long-term portfolio assets, consistent with Serena’s tracking of that cash.
tickets.evidence: the household performance report includes the renovation reserve under long-term portfolio assets even though Serena tracks that cash separately from investable reserves. The agreed work is to revise the renovation reserve reporting classification, dated 2024-12-31.

tickets.title: Address billing account group mismatch
tickets.text: Address the mismatch between the Willowdoodle household’s advisory billing account group and current managed accounts. The billing review screen still includes a closed zero-balance account.
tickets.evidence: the billing review screen still includes a closed zero-balance account in the Willowdoodle household group, creating a mismatch between the invoice allocation view and current managed accounts. The agreed work is to address the billing account group mismatch, dated 2024-12-30.
